readings.moment: The temple struck ten while Girard sat alone in the dining room after dinner.
Girard went out into the street to smoke.
The piano started in the salon just as Girard lit his cigar.
Girard heard faint quick bells from the master's window (twenty-six minutes to eleven).
Girard came back into the house (fourteen minutes to eleven).
The hall clock had just struck eleven when Girard came back into the house.
The hall clock's face showed two minutes past eleven when Girard came back into the house.

durations: About 21 minutes between the temple striking ten (10:00) and Girard going out (10:21 by his watch), assuming the two timepieces agree.
8 minutes between Girard going out (10:21) and the piano starting (10:29), both by his watch.
5 minutes between the piano starting (10:29) and the quick bells (10:34), both by his watch.
12 minutes between the quick bells (10:34) and Girard coming back in (10:46), both by his watch.
25 minutes that Girard was outside, from going out (10:21) to coming back in (10:46), both by his watch.
whereabouts: Girard came up from Le Locle for the dinner at the house.
Girard was at the dinner table with Madame Monnier, Félix, Dr Vauthier, and himself.
After dinner Girard sat alone in the dining room with the brandy.
Girard went out into the street to smoke at 10:21 by his watch.
Girard stayed under the front windows of the house while smoking.
Girard came back into the house at 10:46 by his watch.
Girard went straight up to Félix in the library after coming back in.
According to Girard, Félix was in the library when he went up to him.
Inspecteur Matthey stated that Aurèle Monnier was found dead in his atelier on the top floor of the house.
Girard said he has no wish to leave the town.
